name: Ernst Jünger
summary: A decorated First World War officer who became a radical nationalist writer against Weimar democracy and the bourgeois order, but refused the Nazis. In The Peace (1943) he broke with nationalism and war, calling for a united Europe, justice instead of revenge, and a Christian revival. After 1949 he withdrew from politics.
